attempted_claim: Let (X,d,H^N) be a noncollapsed RCD(0,N) space with integer N>=3 and let u>0 be a locally weak solution of the heat equation on X x (0,T) in the sense of Zhang-Zhu. If equality holds in the sharp global Li-Yau estimate (ln u)_t - |grad ln u|^2 + N/(2t) = 0 at some point (x0,t0), does it follow that X is an N-metric-measure cone over an RCD(N-2,N-1) space with pole at the vertex, and in particular that if the pole is N-regular then X is isomorphic to R^N and u is a constant multiple of the heat kernel?
